question: Which physical quantity represents the rate at which electric energy is dissipated or consumed in an electric circuit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electric Power**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Electric power** is the rate at which **electric energy** is dissipated or consumed in an electric circuit.
 
• The formula to calculate electric power is **P = VI**, where **P** represents power, **V** is the potential difference, and **I** is the current.</l
